item.title: CHINWAG
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
I used to spend my winters with her, there will be books in every nook and cranny of the room. She is choosy about the books she reads and every book once finished would change her character in some way.

I remember once she spend a whole night observing my sleep and arriving at conclusions about it the next day like I just dated a doctor. I wouldn’t mind her clumsiness as every day I get to find something curious to talk about.

Whenever we fought she would run into the woods and sit next to her favourite tree, flapping her legs on the narrow stream like a little kid. I would sit next to her, pick few pebbles and throw one by one to get her attention.

I like her being silly, so I make excuses for fight to enjoy the childishness in her. She would speak without facing me contemplating on how much time we lost last summer because of these silly fights. Her hands were cold as the winds of northern sky and her words had the melancholy of the women in Rossetti’s poems both enough to obliterate my intentional stubbornness.

There were no more memories she hoarded alone, no more paths she trod alone and no more secrets she held alone as I have plundered everything. It wasn’t easy to hold on to that jungle of memories so I created an arboretum where every happy memory of her was a tree and a sad one a dwarf plant.

To the feet that fondled the earth below and walked towards me slowly, holding me close to her chest shattering all secrets I harboured beneath the altar of my memories.

I can see no more roads untraveled as the path had led to where exactly I want to be, the mercy at her feet. It was like listening to an unending play by Vivaldi and Max Richter where I drown in an abyss of carefully crafted tune with violin on a backdrop of single note on piano.

item.title: SKINNY MAN's THOUGHTS
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
FACTS I FIGURED

  • I used to be 5’2” till my 10th but when I graduated my 12th I became 5’9” so I had no other choice other than believe in miracles. (BTW those are measures of height: don’t get confused).
  • I should have born somewhere between July & August. Well I can’t blame my old man on his 30’s because my creation would have been on the bottom of his to do list. So, I became a Capricorn and I have no idea what a Capricorn does or doesn’t.
  • I hate listening to break up stories even though you share explicit content of you intimacy. You should know that love is always out there, it’s just you have to go & find it your own. A note to be taken care when you are finding love is “Think with your mind not with the thing hanging between your legs”.
  • I don’t like papaya and I have wondered why someone would name it Papaya which rhymes to nothing. If you ever order papaya juice while I am next to you, they I would say  “enthu oomban aanu papparekka juice medikunne”.
  • When my ex gave birth to her second child my dad someway found a picture of her from my old wallet and sarcastically said “avide onam randennam kazhinju, evide ethuvare mahabali vannitilla”. I had to show my stupid ass face to the whole family & point out “You guys knew I had a girlfriend?"
  • I have this curiosity to eat things I find very curious and if you observe my friend circle most of them would be plus sized because I order food and If I won’t like it then it’s up to them finish it. That’s my secret of being skinny.
  • I have a very good memory about everything I have experienced and every faces I have interacted with. So, If you are trying to flirt with me avoid using numbers for e.g.: “When is your dad’s birthday?”. I would have to breakup with you then and there.
  • Once a girl told me “if you have told me this three years ago, I would have been yours”. So if any of you owns a special feeling for someone (unless it’s Point: 2 ending) be open about it and don’t carry it so forward that one day you will realize that first sentence would hurt you more than the kick on you tender balls by your best friend.
  • If you feel very romantic about riding in the rain or smelling the raw earth after a good rain, please do it yourself. I know how a good fever and throat pain feels like so I will Netflix and chill but you can go ahead book an Uber and go to cubbon park.
  • I have no idea about the features of bikes or cars, recently only I understood that a single puncture on a Tubeless Tyre would cost 100 INR. Imagine 10 or more punctures, then I would have to sell my kidney.
  • In the gap of a year I have traveled to Delhi-Ladakh-Kashmir-Spiti Valley-Shimla-Manali-Chandigarh (approx 1 month altogether and excluding South India trip). I don’t own a DSLR and I have no idea how buttons works except the ones in my game controller. When I came back from those trip, I became so black that I could do stunt double for Akon in any of his pop songs or a black shadow for anyone.

item.title: FATHER : MY ARTIST & CREATOR
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
My old man was simple, never gave any motivational speech or quotes for me to get inspired. I was never like him, his world revolved around whole family. I haven’t even seen him going out to meet his friends nor did any of his colleagues come home. I used to wonder how he could dedicate his whole life just for family and his cousins.

I have seen him staring at the broken walls and roofs, the ones that needs to be fixed by next monsoon. May be that’s the reason he never invited anyone home until he mends all these things. He owned a Bajaj Chetak whose age is almost identical to mine which still works. He would sell anything (even me) but not that scooter and he would never let me ride that scooter.

Rare are the days when my dad comes before his office hours to pick me up from school and the happiness I felt when I spot him standing near my school gate was unreal. I watched the whole world passed around me while holding tightly across his tummy leaning towards his back.

I have never told him (not even once may be) how much I love him nor wished on his birthday but all the gifts I bought for him might have spoken. He goes through my salary slip, file my taxes, and check my bank records but never asked for money till now. He would say if you have excess money just give it to your mom she will handle it for you.

He would brag in front of everyone that “My son is working as a consultant in an American company (stressing on American)” then some days he would shout in front of everyone “Listen, My son is an engineer working for an MNC who doesn’t even know how to fill a bank challan, how old are you now son”.

Whenever I got hurt while playing, my dad would say “This is nothing vichu, it will heal soon”. He held me close and said “When you grow up, you will realize that some things won’t heal no matter how much time it takes” and he was right.

item.title: FLIGHT
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded: I boarded my very first flight in 2012 to Delhi in order to break-up with my girlfriend(ex). I just disappeared from Bangalore one fine day & reached back three days later without informing anyone. I was scared to visit Delhi as my uncle & aunt stays in Mayur Vihar & I didn't want to stumble upon them one fine day morning in Rajiv Chowk Metro. So I stayed with my friend Yogesh in Pari Chowk, Greater Noida where the chances of anyone recognising me is less than zero. Technically there was no need to travel that far for any breakup but I like to visit historical places So I intentionally created a cause for it. We broke up on the first day itself at Humanyuns Tomb which used to be a good place but currently allocated to teens who can't afford Oyo Rooms & same goes with Purana Quila. I had two more days to spend there, I broke up with her again the 2nd day at Lotus Temple & broke up with her again on the 3rd day at Palika Bazaar. She even bought me a pair of shorts from Palika Bazaar & if I remember it's an air conditioned market. So the next day I had to catch the return flight to bangalore. She called & said "Hey, I will come & meet you before you leave" & as promised she came & bargained with an auto wala to drop me at Terminal 1D & left for her work in urge.I reached Terminal 1D just 20mins before the flight & was trying to weave of the impending sadness of my life. Suddenly the auto guy told me "Sir, Idhar Indigo Flights Nahi Ayega, Ye galat terminal hain? Aapko T3 Jaana padega aur vo thoda door hain plus 300bucks extra padega" I was literally fucked that day & I had only 220 bucks in my wallet & this guy wasn't ready to take me there without the required money. I informed him that I am just returning back from a bad break up & I am really worried if I would miss my flight. He became really sad and took my bag inside his auto & said "bheto sir, I will take you there as soon as possible & pay me only 200". We took almost 10mins to reach there & by then we became good friends and he even asked me to come & meet him at Pahar Ganj next time I visit Dilli. The sad part was those shorts won't fit me when I came back to bangalore. #StopItVishnu   Like & Share 😎

item.title: WHISKEY
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded: My best friend once hooked me up with his friend hoping things would work between us which could help to recover me from my breakup. I texted her & said that I am not good at starting a conversation but she texted me back this. "Meet me at 6 in the evening at my place & bring a bottle of whiskey too". I texted John & said "Haven't you told her that I am teetotaller". John said "That's for her macha, now just go meet her". So I wore my Jim Morrison's tee & reached her place. She greeted me & said "Its a mess around here but I can definitely find a chair for both of us". Alas! she sat on a chair & I got a stool where I had to be conscious of my balance. I told her that I dont remember the last time I sat on one though. I offered her the whiskey & with no shame she started to beat shots one by one. She bought me coffee on a little cup but good lord! it was brutally tasty & I wanted to ask for one more cup but I thought let it be. I watched her drink the last drop of that whiskey without even slithering she walked around the room. I asked her "Do you want me to get one more whiskey, clearly that didn't even made you a bit tipsy". She spend most of her time drawing & her rooms were filled with sheet of paintings & rough sketches. I assume that the things she drew are those vivid hallucinations inside her head and she can't explain the meaning of any of those paintings. We played some classic rock songs with alternate turns for eachother. We started picking one by one until it was 12 in the night & the room is well arranged now plus we had another cup of coffee. I politely said "I have no idea why I came here but we did have fun especially the coffee! I will miss that for sure & I gestured that it's time for me to leave". She hugged me & said thanks for coming by. As I was about to start my bike & leave, she called me & said "could you please come in, I need some help". As I entered her room, she was there throwing all the drawings here & there just like how it was before. I yelled "Are you crazy?". She replied "Don't leave Vishnu, Could you play your favorite song again. Do you want cup of coffee again Vichu?" #stopitvishnu

item.title: CHOICE OF A MOUNTAIN MAN
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
I always wanted someone who would chase the madness of the mountains and run alongside me. I don’t want it to be named as love, love is predictable and I know where that hunger would lead to. To travel without a plan but with a map and stare at the unadulterated wilderness of the raw nature. A person who would value time more than money and know the fact that happiness is only real when shared. I came across many temporary faces over the years but no one had the audacity to break out of the comfort zone which always hurted me. There is a story of a lone farmer who lived near the river bank for decades but never climbed the mountain and when the flood came he climbed the mountain only to realize that there was a whole village on the other side. I want that someone to be a little selfish because happiness never drove humans beyond the comfort zone.

I always wanted someone who would come and eat with me at any place and not comparing the place with the standard of their living. Not to the fancy ones, not with one who’s fussy about the decoration or how splendid it would taste. One of the tastiest food I ever had been prepared inside an Indian Clay Pot supported by three bricks where my mother would blow air to burn the wooden sticks with a bit of kerosene oil and a match box. She would pour some hot curry on my palm and ask me to taste it and you can’t buy that feeling anywhere else because those where my roots. I want someone who should understand that the costliest dish isn’t always the best one.

I always wanted someone who could answer my questions with a “Yes or No” instead of saying “let me see if”. I always try to stick to that because it is a huge mistake to lead someone if you aren’t sure of the answer. Have you ever tried saying “I Love You” to your friend rather than to the person you have feelings for, it takes a lot of courage to do that but your comfort is somewhere else.

Once I was attending a live concert in Bangalore and the artist paused for a while and said “Turn to your right and say I Love You to the stranger next to you” and there stood a girl wearing a Zeppelin t-shirt and pierced nose. Rest is history.

item.title: AGE : A DAGGER OF FEAR
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
You should be scared of your age and nothing else because with age comes choices and with choices comes fear, the fear of impending outcomes. You start missing what you thought you would never miss and you pointlessly drag your choices without thinking if it's necessary to carry it along. You should find love by then, not the one who changes every time you look but the one who would stay when everything changes around you. With age you have to decide whether to trust your instincts or follow your heart and amidst that chaos you have to find a place to sleep comfortably.

We are species who push for a better choice rather than finding something to settle with, we ignore what our past have taught us and walk along the same path once we promised not to but this time you have very little time to make choices. You might have the energy to fight physically but not mentally, then you realize that the choices that you made were wrong again. With age you can't keep your pain inside, you start sharing your stories pointlessly to others hoping they you listen and laying your morose heart to rest for a while but can you still sleep calmly every night?

[caption id="attachment_114" align="aligncenter" width="687"] shot on OnePlus5T[/caption]  

All your thoughts can be simplified only if you could go back in time and fix everything back to normal but then you realize for that instant that what you are thinking right now is another dream in reality. With age you should sacrifice your happiness for others and that's how this world have been running till date. If you are standing there hoping to make a decision to alter your life forever then you are the most stupidest person alive or if you are trusting in your Lord then again you are stupid because you can't compile all your fears and spread on his feet one fine day hoping to be happy for the rest of your life.

So, Fall in Love before everything falls apart. Find courage in saying that you love because that's where your saviour is not at that ruined shore of relentless pain and sadness. With age you can't find your saviour but find love which is almost the same thing. With age you will find everything beautiful and painful at the same time so find love.

item.title: MIRRORS WITH FACES
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
I get very curious about everything I see and I prefer to enjoy that curiousness alone. There was a church near my home back in Alappuzha,Kerala where they play ambient prayer songs which I used to listen for decades. I used to stare across the window pane through the trees that cloaked the church, the songs would bring mild winds of sleep to my bedroom. I could sleep peacefully without zeroing on any specific memories.

Since then I had this urge to listen to a lot minimal music recordings especially by Max Richter, Antonio Vivaldi, Philip Glass, Ludovico Einaudi etc. Their recording were a compilations of raw voices for example a women would be reciting a poem while a type writer noise runs in the backdrop, compilation of the waves beating towards sea shores, a mix of piano and violin with discreet hang volume in the background, a hum of a young girl plucking the roses from her garden. It’s very hard to explain about it because it’s something that have to be felt to be understood.

[caption id="attachment_137" align="aligncenter" width="3350"] St. Mary's Church[/caption]

I write when I miss someone, most times I intend to write something for her but it ends up becoming something else. Mostly, I write only things I have experienced or witnessed happening to someone I know. It’s easy to think but to put the right words to make someone else imagine the same needs pure passion.  I wanted to write about those memories or about those faces that have made a difference in my life but instead of respecting the time I have invested in knowing them they try to let off the burden they are carrying for a long while on me.

While trying to find my curiousness elsewhere I forgot about her, I failed to send her letters or flowers but most importantly I failed to tell her how much i have changed. One day before leaving her side forever, she held my hand tightly for one last time and asked “Do you know the connection between you and poetry? I love both when I am sad.” I wasn't sure whether to leave or stay.

item.title: DANCE OF TORMENT
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
Agnus danced all her fears away, the voices inside her were too overwhelming for her control. I have seen her at the corner of her room, scared and paranoid to sleep due to the painful repetitions of the nightmares she once endured.

She would turn on the tape and slowly move around the room before picking up the momentum, it feels like she is following an afterglow until its stand still. She once told me that when everything is still dance starts. The lights were turned off, only lights through curtains were visible and she would dance around that space like a little butterfly catching up with the wind. She would stretch more than her height without tripping & that's my favourite part.

*Background music slowly fades and a vivid contemporary music plays*

I would tap my feet gently to the music she played while she danced around the hall like a young bird who learned to fly who moves from one tree to another carelessly. I wanted this moment to echo in a beautiful repetition but for her it's the dance of her torment, the dance with the devil as she calls it. 

[caption id="attachment_143" align="aligncenter" width="661"] Kochi-Muziris Biennale[/caption]

The tear marks on her cheeks mixed with the kohl are still visible but she never asked for sympathy or forgiveness but danced for salvation. Hard are those twists and turns like the cold breeze that chills your spine in winter. She never turned or looked back at me ever since she started her dance, my existence was merely felt there and it felt like she created a world of her own while she danced, it's was pure magic. She calls her dance a prayer, a dance to forget the torment induced by a group of men that night while they burned her house down.

I, an orphan neglected by everyone around me, who is scared to wander alone, who failed to follow my master had a revelation when I met her. I sat at the same place every day and watched her dance, at times I wanted her to take my hand and dance with me but never she asked nor showed any empathy towards my smile.

Today, I walked towards her and asked “Will you teach me how to dance? but I don’t have anything to give in return”. She smiled at me for the first time and asked me to hold her hip tight. I still remember who cried that day, such a beautiful repetition indeed.

item.title: RESURRECTION
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
My grandma became very cute and skinny on her 80’s with pure white hair and wrinkles covered most part of her skin. Her name was Ganga, sweet and beautiful as I remember or may be the most beautiful women I met other than my mom and she harboured a smile, she smiled just like a young kid caught stealing something from the attic.

Her leg had to be cut off because of high sugar levels and my poor Ganga was blind by then while her leg was removed.I still remember the day when she was gained conciousness and she was trying to feel her leg only to realize that its been removed. She was sad when she got to know that she no more had a leg even though it was inevitable for her survival. She started crying like a little kid who lost something valuable she kept inside in her treasure chest.

Once I was not allowed to leave for my Boy Scouts Program while she was admitted in hospital due to serious illness. That was the first time my dad called and informed me that my grandma might pass away in few days and the doctors can't do anything about it. 

I became really sad and I went next to her and said “Don’t worry you are just fine. You will live for another 5 years, so chill old lady”. Guess what, she passed that ordeal & stayed with me for another 5  more years.

I used to get food for her which my mom prepares and she would be sitting in her bed scratching her hair trying to kill the laces she could catch hold of while keeping her ear next to the fingers just to hear it pop. As soon as she hears my call that face would lift and ask “Is it Vichu?” and I would gladly acknowledge it with a yes and spread the plates in front of her. I take her hand & touch each plates and tell her “this is rice, this is beans, this is curd, this is water” and slowly she starts to eat with no teeth in her mouth. Sometime she would cry while eating which was hard for me to stay and watch, I wasnt sure if it was because of happiness or sadness nor I will ever know.

She was suffering enough day by day as days passed while nothing could be done. Some days, when I go near her, she would ask me to come close to her so that she could kiss me and that was the sweetest thing I ever felt. I was her favorite child since the day I was born, the one who took care of me more than my mom or dad ever did. She passed away one day morning since it was an impending scenario for everyone most of my uncle and aunts handled the situation but my mom was torn apart. I being one of the eldest kid had to perform the rituals but I was never sad about the fact that she left me forever. I still remember that it rained really well that day and I was standing wearing a dhoti witnessing her being covered with woods until I couldn’t see her anymore. It was really cold standing in the rain witnessing the ceremony from a distance while the younger siblings of mine have no idea what to do. My eldest uncle had to light the fire as the last ritual and everyone started to talk about the following rituals to be done once this is over but by then Vishnu couldn’t handle it, I broke down and cried. I couldn’t handle that pain by then, I didn't just lose someone I loved so much instead I lost someone who loved me more than I ever could. I cried all the way back home, that was one of the few times I lost myself somewhere which I couldn’t still explain. I still could feel the shiver when I think about that feeling.

item.title: W A Y W A R D
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
Before you, I have stumbled on many faces, many fingers have fondled my hair and many lips have tasted mine but not my soul. I have succumbed to lust even before I could experience love and my attachment to those faces never flourished past a monsoon. The scream of their submissions were not by force or charms but with words, carefully crafted words indeed and I wrote love letters to them with an intention to make them vulnerable Every word I penned undermined how much I loved them which made them weak because my letters were the purest form of love they ever experienced. For me finding words for them wasn’t hard a glass of bourbon whiskey and a neat rolled blunt was enough to make them leave their last resort and run towards me as their false saviour.  

I have slept on their lap narrating stories for their own impending destruction but somedays I wished if they knew my intentions but their love towards me was simply impervious to doubts. I would write intense letters during the last week of that season for them as I knew it was time for me to depart and the monster inside me meticulously enjoyed the pain they brought upon themselves. I had a jaded dairy with pictures of them pinned on dates to remind me of the pain I caused which I skim before going to sleep. My madness became non curable by then and if anybody could save me then that would be myself. I had no fear of death by then because death would be the most beautiful thing I could experience as I could write about it when I am reborn in the next. For me death would be my salvation, to run into a field with no boundaries and to sleep under the old tree where I am reborn everyday. I have made them smile during the darkest part of their life giving them hope to thrive on yet no one cared to ask about my happiness. Do you understand now why I do this? Why I choose this path of self-righteous treachery? Why I chose lust while the whole world was stuck between love and hatred?

item.title: T W I S T E D
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
Once I chained her to a memory of mine, a memory that had the backdrop of a piano fusion playing endlessly. I sat on my chair and watched her dance as she made turns in the air while the scarf played on her hips and I sit there imagining "How would I feel without her even for a day".

She was the epicentre for all the poetry I wrote, she was the beginning of the pain and twisted memories I had to endure and she was the end of the dark and empty paths I travelled. She was an afterglow I chased, the lover I am now, the music I listen to, the rose I held on a pale moonlit night, the reason I love night than day. Everything was for her, she was a broken piece of puzzle that failed to fit the society we lived in. She loved me for the words I bequeathed for her on that piece of paper few years ago even though I never informed about the lies I compiled for her.

One day, I left a note compiling all the lies I told her and left the place only with a photograph in hand. I thought I would find a better place without her, I wanted to start everthing over for myself and to chase a dream on a drag where I dont intend to hold any more hands but a stick when I am old.

I barely slept that night, I used to admire the dark and the woods but something was wrong somewhere and an inceassant sadness started to overpower my confidence. So I ran, ran into the wilderness like a madman, I have fallen many times by then and broke my knees yet I limped back all the way. It started to hurt on every inch of my body as the paths were made of thorns and stones but it wasn't even close to the pain thinking about the promise I broke. I lost my left eye on the last fall and I could barely see through the dark now. I knew I'm very close to her home now and I could see the lights fluttering on the wooden steps.

I wanted to apologize and ask for mercy on her feet, so I ran to her room and cried out her name but only to see her hanging down on the ceiling holding the letter I wrote for her few years ago while the piano fusion played endlessly.

item.title: R A G G E D
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
I admire mountains over any other natural wonders. I would sit and wonder how majestically it stood and one day it would let off its rage to the village below leaving death and torment throughout the valley

Once I stumbled on a stranger while walking along the woods of Kheerganga, he sat near a corner stone leaning his back towards the wall. His bag pack was spread in front of him, I presumed that he was searching for the “charas” he kept somewhere inside his torn bag and subsequently blowing his chillum to clear off intended dust. I sat across him at a distance of few feet giving me the advantage to run in case he turns out to be an angry pothead I encountered. I understood he didn’t had any matchbox to light but he never looked at me or asked for help. I called at him and threw the matchbox towards him but landed somewhere near him, so he extended his comfort zone and reached over the matchbox and lighted his chillum without saying a thanks or giving back the box. [caption id="attachment_166" align="aligncenter" width="686"] Kheerganga,Kasol[/caption]

After taking a humongous drag of clean hash, he gestured me to join him or sit close to him, I was hesitant at first and told him that I was about to leave now. He asked “Are you scared looking at me? Are you scared of a man sitting near a corner smoking our nature’s most beautiful medicine”. I said “May be but I am curious to talk to you too”.

He became very hostile when I said I don’t want to smoke the hash, he said you just ignored the most sacred gift from my Lord, the one who resides on top these mountains watching over all of us. He told me few things later, which made me think a lot and I spend almost 3hrs listening to his stories and listening to his songs where he would raise his hands and his whole hair would dance alongside that and chant Bole Nath Ki Jai!. He told me that I shouldn’t look for happiness at a single place instead knock on every door I find curious about. The idea behind knocking is not to be answered by anyone but when you knock you realize what you are looking for. item.title: HIDDEN

I used to hide behind an old tree in my backyard while my friends counted from one to twenty. I used to share my secrets with that tree and considered the movement of branches as the acknowledgement for listening to me. I used to hug that tree every day until I found happiness under her curvy lips.

Years later I came back to my first home and without wasting much time I ran into the woods to find the same old tree and surprisingly it was there. It stood alone between the pines cloaking the height it stood. I remember how tall it was the last time I climbed, I could see the whole mountains and the village that stood beyond the river. I couldn’t reach across the old tree now, few birds and squirrels are his company now. I laid down facing the old tree telling him how much things changed once I left the village.

“I am stuck between the lines of a song and the smile on her curly lips and I am constantly torn apart with that dream. I was hurt whenever I held a rose for her it felt like treasuring the silence after a storm. I could hear a norse drum playing in the background only to awaken the rage inside me while I hold the rose tightly inside my palm. We are futile species who are programmed to get hurt for every silly thing and ponder over prolonged memory drags."

Hurt is a magical word they said few blame others for the reason and few believes that it would turn them into a better human. You get hurt when you listen to your favorite song or when you’re denied by your loved one or when the world denies your choice or when you imagine someone else holding his/her hand.

You have endured everything the seasons had to offer yet you grew bigger and taller but today, I came here to see if you have kept my secret safe. I dug near the roots to find a little treasure box that I once hid and it had been a long while since I buried my hand in soil.

I dug deep until I stumbled my fingers on something and with much happiness I looked up to the tree. I cried leaning towards the old tree holding that old box which held my first tooth.

This so-called loneliness never hurt me but it made me dream so much that I understood that if I leave this place then the chances of coming back with a scar was impending. So silently I lay and observe the world around me from that corner of my room.

That was the place I called home, a place where my unending dreams were followed by continued silence. Those days were filled with songs and poetry followed by multiple drags to amplify these feelings. There was no space for anger or lust but something far more worse was available there which I call as HOPE.

Remember! when you scratch the walls of your own sadness in search for happiness outside, it's not your home anymore.

item.title: HER NOTEBOOK
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
Recently I volunteered to talk to a women who was mentally ill and I was pre informed that she tried to end her life once by hanging and once by ripping off her veins but was miraculously saved both times. Post that scenario she became real quiet and spend most times reading books and poetry and Vishnu became very curious to meet her, to understand  and observer how fickle minded she was. I met her & said “You look lovely today but I heard you f****d up really bad last time”. She smiled and said “Yes, Vishnu I did”. I politely said "Please dont ruin my day with any mental break downs, I am really not prepared for it."

I asked her “Do you repent on what you did? I heard that you stood in a pool of your own blood while holding on to that pain”. She said “I want to say yes but deep inside I know it’s not true”. I said “Let’s talk about your fears not the ones you are scared of but the ones that’s inside your head that wakes you up every night”.

But before starting off a proper conversation she wanted to know how old I was turning this year.

 

She said “Vishnu, I don’t fear anything physically but I fear time and with age I became emotionally weak. I was scared of losing things I treasured, scared to share happiness with a random guy who would walk through that door, scared to stop all the imaginations I own and start something new, scared that my freedom will soon be a paradox, I am scared due to the inability to choose what’s right for me, whether to forget him or stand with him. The hardest part is what if I am making the wrong choice & I could never come back?”. She looked at me and asked “Vishnu, Do you think I am too emotional now?” I just nodded. She asked again “ So you just nod after I say everything I felt? ” and I nod again. I realized that the hallucinations I had from that mush in Kodai was nothing compared to the ones she was talking about, she never slept for a week even on high dose painkillers and sleeping tablets. I always believed that suppressor medicines could overpower any mental thoughts but it wasn't. I have seen drawing done by people who had mental breakdowns but from her I realized that it was far worse. She said some days she couldn't close her eyes because someone would whisper on her ears to jump off the building. (and that dialogue really scared the shit out of me)

[caption id="attachment_252" align="aligncenter" width="4608"] Munnar,Kerala[/caption]

We talked for few hours and in between her mom brought a glass of lemonade and God! it was awful but I smiled at her and said thanks. She loved quotes and poems of Thoreau and Kahlil Gibran but I hate Kahlil Gibran for his frequent use of divinity in his poems and monotonous thoughts that he had been using in all of his works. He is one of the poets I genuinely hate. 

So I introduced her to John Clare and Walt Whitman, I recited “Bivouac On A Mountain Side by Walt Whitman” (if you dont know then you should) & asked her to close her eyes & imagine what I recite. There was a long silence for few seconds until she cried and said "The stars in the sky Vishnu, the stars are very beautiful".

[caption id="attachment_253" align="aligncenter" width="1235"] Madhugiri,Karnataka[/caption]

I could have given a solution for her illness but deep inside I know she wasn't ready to accept anything and I was more than sure that she wouldn't try anything stupid too because there is nothing that a little poetry can't cure. John Clare saved himself So can Joanna.

item.title: MOTHER
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
I used to lie to my mom about my exam results just to make her sad and out of anger she would scold me and start crying involuntary just because she raised her voice at me but I would tell her that I was just joking and I got good marks.

But this was not the case if I scored less marks , I would run to the terrace and stand close to the else so that I could scare her with the fact that I would jump if she came near me. The only way I am coming down to ground zero was only if she promises not to cane me. She would say "Don’t worry Vichu, I won’t tell dad about anything" and the first thing she would do is feed me really good and wait till Dad arrives back from his work and submit me as a present to him so that he could cane me really nice.

Even though she did the same thing every time I loved her more and more because she would feed me dinner from her own hands at the end of the day. No matter how much hardship she had to face while growing up or while taking care of her old blind mother, she was the epitome of love. She cared for everyone around no matter they are related or not, she would sit and cry for someone else's sadness. I think part of that gene have passed down on me and I blame her for myself being very emotional sometimes.

I grew up watching her lighting the lamp at 6.30pm sharp and chanting slokas she knew or trying out a new one she learned recently. Sick or not, she would wake up early at 5am so that little Vichu could get his glass of tea in his bed and till now I can't remember a day when she was around and I woke up without having tea. She wont listen to me but I have to listen to her even now like I said I am still that 5-year-old boy for her even though I turned 29 few months back.

I sacrificed many things that were precious to me just to see that smile on her face. No matter how many things I bought for her she would say "why are you buying this old women all these fancy things" but the next day, while walking on the road some random aunt would come and say "Hey Vishnu, that saree was really beautiful, how much did you pay for that". That was my mom, I didn't have to check-in facebook but whole locality would know that I bought her a saree and its good. 

There were many days of chaos and loneliness and every day I wished I could hug her and tell her “I miss you so much” and to sleep in her lap while she read a fancy weekly digest. Whenever I go home, She would hug me & say sleep a little more as tea is getting ready and when I wake up she is there with a cup of tea in an old silver glass , the same silver glass used since my childhood.

Sometimes I know that she is wrong but I just nod and say "yes mom you are right". No matter how old I am, she still feeds me if she had the time and she would open her mouth along with me involuntary enacting whenever I swallowed a handful of rice.She knows I save money but she’s scared that I would travel somewhere one fine day to places she haven’t heard of.

Whenever I felt sad, I would remember about those days when I sat on her hip and munched on a piece of fish fry while she points at a crow and say “Vishnu, If you don’t eat this, he will come and eat it, so eat”

item.title: LOVE FADES DEATH BLOOMS
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
I consider myself among the broken ones, the unloved, the one who carries the penance of his own masquerade while everyone sleep in peace. I can’t stay for more than two years in a relationship and that’s one of the key thing I insist when love starts to blossom. I was willing to bequeath relationships in order to find something new in me that the person before her failed to unlock.

Love is like that butterfly you see on your backyard, once she finds the most beautiful flower she steals the nectar and would never come back on the same flower ever again. The idea of Love is to find the right person in you to settle with rather than finding the right person to settle with.

[caption id="attachment_313" align="alignnone" width="694"] Munnar[/caption]

Few years back there were no captions under #StopItVishnu and none of the hands that fondled me could figure out that I could write until she came. Once she left I was left with thoughts of solitude and hatred that continued for months until it was overpowered by another women’s warmth. With her I learned honesty that I failed to grow my own where in my priorities was put aside for her smile until I could no more feel special. I left that paradox of honesty into the wind as I walked away with someone else who introduced me into poetry and within her there was a mélange of emotions that was ready to be infused into me. With her I learned poetry and slowly changed myself into a character for her to play with while I enjoyed the outcome of her imaginations until I was asked to walk into the woods with someone I recently met. I left the world of poetry for someone new whom I rambled into the woods without thinking about the impending outcomes. She was the one who taught me to listen to my heart even though it’s hard to say NO and the first one who brought me my first backpack and told me to travel without the fear of coming back and she was the first one to tell “don’t come back for me again Vishnu”.

I have experienced Love in different forms, some fixed the cure for my stubbornness but some lifted my chin & kissed to say don’t cry. If I look back I can see that I tried to run before I could walk but it also takes courage to walk away when everything around is happy because of you. I still might not have understood Love but to the long roads ahead filled with solitude, poetry & woods I am not scared to control the outcome of my life because I know that I'm the master of my faith not you nor any of your Gods.

item.title: SMILE
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
Today I met a young girl who was trying to sell a bunch of red roses, she walked past everyone and asked if they needed one. I was standing next to her drinking a pop soda and listening to "Rising Of The Tide" by Blackfield. No one was interested in buying a flower from her, I guess the days of showing love with flowers has been ascended to dinner at a pricy restraunt or laying in bed going dutch on a cigarette.

She asked me  "Anna do you want some flowers", generally these street kids who sell items tend to walk behind you until you get mad at them but she wasn't even trying. I informed her that I dont have anyone currenty so that I can gift these flowers to and I said I would pay for two flowers but I cant take it from you. She asked me give it to the girl whom I have a crush on. I said "thats a clever way(psycological move) of selling  but sadly I dont have the guts to tell that girl I even have a crush on her and I'm done with all these silly feelings now".

She said the guy she loves sells the same flowers near Commercial Street only and every morning they would meet, count and tie these flowers together and that's the only time she could see him because post evening he goes and stays with his friends. I enquired about her age and she said shes 12 with a smile and its was a like a tube light in a dark room, her face was covered in much dirt. I told her that "When I was 12, I was on top of a mango tree near my home trying to pluck mangoes for my friends and I barely thought about love. You already have a lot of inhibitions to enjoy a happy life yet you are already in love with a random guy who you meet every morning."

[caption id="attachment_308" align="aligncenter" width="552"] 32 Watt Smile[/caption]

She ordered me to ask her how does she know that he loves her? and she said, While we tied roses everyday, I found one rose extra and hes asks me to keep it. First I thought it was a mistake but everyday the same incident happened as he handed over me an extra rose until I realised he loved me and since then I had an extra rose to keep for myself. I kept that rose with me even though I could sell it off and make money. So if he has the guts to do that then you too can brother. While I smirked, she asked will you do it brother? I gladly said, one day I would and I will meet you that day and buy that whole bunch from you for her. She refused to take the money from me & walked away.

Few days later I did approach the girl whom I had a crush on and with no shame I admitted what I felt. She replied that she wasnt sure how she would react for it but she was glad that I told her about this.

Now I have to go to MG.Road and find that kid and say that her black brother kept his word and he is dating someone now but not her. So, gimme those damn flowers.😅 #StopItVishnu

item.title: U N C L E

I owe my uncle a lot, right from the day he started picking me up from pre school on the front seat of his bicycle to dropping me at the railway station in his autorickshaw whenever I returned back to Bangalore.Poor guy he is, who loves me a lot more than his kids and I grew up shifting my place from the front seat of his bicycle to the pillion seat of the same bicycle.

I remember the day when he forgot to pick me up from school and it was slightly raining, almost every kids left the school but I stood there crying asking the caretaker "where is my uncle" and she replied that he hadn't come yet.I cried until he came and he held me close and said "I am really sorry da, I slept off".I realized that he couldn't stand seeing me cry and he never ever came late since then. He drives an autorickshaw with a label named Ganga (named after my grandmother) and that's what his livelihood is/was and no other source of income he had. He is a person who stores an abundance of love inside his heart which I have seen and felt ever since I saw him and half of my childhood was on his shoulders than on my parents.

He is the one who took me to watch theater films & also bought cassettes so that everyone can watch it together. He used to bring me daily a packet of groundnuts from the local seller who roams around my hood. He is my moms closest brother & if I give him some money to spend then the first thing he would do is to inform her that I gave him some money.

His name is Gopakumar but for me he is my Gomaman and it's been 30 years I have been using that name. I don't think I can ever been a brother who loves his sister as much as he do & I remember the day when he was admitted in hospital & my mom was crying relentlessly telling me he is not well.

I am proud to be born to a middle class family who ordealed through many crisis to become what I am now but when I look at him who drives an autorickshaw for living and still be the same person I have met 20 years back and still loves me the same way as If I am picked back from my school.

item.title: BIPOLAR

What have I done to myself? I thought in time my mind would stop preaching me about things that I am trying to forget and even though I try breaking it down it to a granular level that thought someway manages to find a way back in and it pull me down from the center of my consciousness and it hurts me more than anything I have endured. I haven’t really dealt with depression nor have understood how it feels but what if this is it? Is this why I can’t pursue happiness.

My playlists have been have moved from progression to sad melodies and I can’t pretty much make anyone understand what I am going through and I don’t intend to. I thought as I grew up the things inside my mind would fade and polish it with happiness, but I realized that I was always controlled by my mind just like injecting a dream drug whenever I realize that I am no more oblivious to my thoughts.

I always believed that I have endured enough pain in my life so that I won’t contemplate over silly feelings but to make my point clear I had to drown in what I have once endured and if I look closely I am losing myself to what I have always been running away from.

How diabolical is life? I used to enjoy that essence of unknown happiness while being sad or gloomy but now I can’t nurture an emotion when I am sad, and the pillars of every thoughts have slowly eroded, taking me through a path I don’t want to be part of. Maybe this is what “V. Woolf” felt too, only to drown in a river with pockets filled with rocks so that no more thoughts can control her sanity.

There was a time when everything felt real and the things that I have seen and felt were connected to a glorious dream but now I see no more. I only see withered trees, broken souls with bipolar thoughts, yet I find comfort in that because one day I will be over looked the same way saying he was different. I won’t need stones to drown because once I fall I don’t dream of waking up again and I would drift in that sweet abyss of continued silence.

item.title: BUTTERFLY AND I
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
There was a butterfly in the woods who had a wing deformation, it could only fly upto the height of a grass, while every others enjoyed nectar from the flowers he fluttered on top of grass and dandelions to suck on the dew. He never understood the taste of sweetness yet the little one enjoyed what the ground could offer.

Every morning he would flap his broken wings to see if he could reach up just to see how the flowers would look like, sometimes he would stand close to the wind to see if it could throw him up and land on top of one but there has not been a lucky day

The little one loved playing with the flightless friends on the ground and he would wake up early to enjoy the morning dew that falls on the grass but no matter how content he is with his small world everyone else would still call him a Loser.


I have always been that butterfly who couldn't reach where other were, I chose to stay with things that made me content. I never ran to find an opportunity thinking that I would miss things on the way so I walked slow and stumbled on things I found curious because my heart demanded it. May be I never explained what my thoughts are to others, may be I never will.

I have dreams of an eternal paradise where my thoughts doesn't decay, I have access to every memory and fantasies that I once harbored. If given a choice, I would choose to think about love on an endless loop as there was nothing else to be recalled as fun.

I feel like I have lost my mind somewhere and I am not able to figure out where. I can only feel the pain yet there is no chaos to find the origin of this hurt. I am not dreaming well these days, may be there is a limit to where my mind can organize emotions. I tried to mend this pain by substituting karma but sometimes I feel I am burdening myself with pointless conversations.

I wish I was a little butterfly so that I could be friends with you, we could enjoy the morning dew together and be content for what the present have given us. When they call us as losers it may hurt but little they knew about finding happiness in places where others failed to stop and explore.

item.title: What's Happening?
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
I moved on from a lot of thoughts and I should thank this pandemic for giving a break from some routines. I had a lot of time in learning a few tricks and I must admit that I am becoming a little smart at coding now. I keep myself very occupied and I don't let myself be idle, I either check stock market or find patterns for the next intraday trading. If you don't understand the above sentence then you aren't saving your money in the right way, once you step into stock market its like the same feeling when you jerked off for the very first time, what the fuck is happening!. Lets not divert from the topic, we aren't going to discuss about stocks here. I just want to say that its kind of my interest now apart from 9-5 job.

Well, how long its been sober? I really don't know and only my body knows. I miss gym not because I workout and all, I like doing cardio while listening to my playlist. The gym instructor Babu likes me because I pay rent at the right time and I hope he dint go broke during this pandemic. I left my bike in Bangalore and here I have to ride my dad's Bajaj Discover which my dad thinks is the best bike of the decade and expect him, we all tell him this bike needs to be sold. I tried convincing him to buy a gearless scooter but he doesn't budge. My generation of parents are a little crazy and emotional at the same time.

I don't see any significance of Facebook in my life and I would probably deactivate it because I am unsure when was the last time I liked someone's status or profile pic. Instagram is overwhelming but its a good place to keep in touch than WhatsApp because end of the day everyone joins Instagram for no reason. I think its a good place to keep in touch with your old acquaintances and ex-girlfriends. Some of my ex-gfs might not ask how I am doing but would ask to give a follow to an Instagram page created by her sister, like regular Karma wasn't doing enough damage. Rest of em' are still in touch with occasional meme forwarding or generic conversation and I am glad that even after all these years we could still be friends plus Instagram is a good place to stalk and get away with.

Few of my friends who are couples told me that they prefer still staying or adjusting in Bangalore rather than spending time with their parents during this pandemic because they cant adjust staying at in-laws. I feel sympathy for them because if not now then when do they need your support. Since 2010, this is the first time I am staying with my parents for a long time and I realized that my parents are hiding some much physical pain that doesn't appear via phone calls and are suppressed via prescription pills. I will write about the experience at home in another blog because recently there was a scenario that moved me a lot. So, what I am trying to convey here is that while you are trying to adjust away from home you fail to understand that home needs your care more than ever.

Yesterday I was realized that ever since I moved to online music streaming, I never listen to the ones I have already on my phone memory card and its the same song which I have locally I try to stream. Its like the meme "in search for gold we lost a diamond", The songs in my phone brings more memories and add a random thumbnail art of a random picture from my gallery also, its like you are listen to Pink Floyd but the album art says "www.daddydilruba.com", its really awkward to play in front of someone so I switched to poweramp which downloads the correct album art. I have this fetish over listening to songs with the correct album art, may be that's the reason why I prefer Spotify. I consider those who listen to artists like "Vancouver Sleep clinic" ,"Angus and Julia Stone" or "Iron and Wine" etc as musically smart because not everyone stumbles on these bands, its either a luck or a suggestion by someone close. I still use the old winamp on my laptop to listen to music just because I like the skins of it and the amount of modifications you can do with it, always nostalgic.

I have been missing good Biryani like the ones in Bangalore, here in Alleppey restaurants are fucking bad, like the word fucking isn't serving enough justice. Its just one or two decent restaurants that's it. I missing having spicy Andra Biryani from Annapoorna mess with a coke and halfway realizing that your nose is sweating and ass is on fire. Its a hard task to walk back to desk after lunch but the taste is worth dying for. We recently came to know that the owner passed away due to heart attack but the people who are still running it are making sure that it still live up to the standards. Biryani can pretty much solve any fights.

There was a period where gaming was everything like PC games, the amount of time spend exploring maps and playing side quests was always fun but progressively it all went away. The amount of scolding I received from my gf's for not making time for skype were unreal but little they knew about pressure of entering a boss fights without using cheat codes, its a mental preparation plus only if it saves right before the fight, some fights you might need to start all over again. Only if you have played Devil May Cry or Metal Gear Solid you would understand how hard it is plus I always play hard mode because the ones below that mode are for noobs. During college playing Counter Strike was the best thing, enter into a random room and play until you get an alert from the data provider because 1Gb was the standard limit every month. You play a YouTube video and there goes you 100mb in 5mins, forget about accessing Pornhub the moment the whole page loads with the gifs and pictures half of your monthly quota would have been depleted. Life was a slow back then accompanied by a PC running with 256mb RAM and 40Gb memory. Does 40Gb HDD exist anymore? Naa!!

I hate getting throat pain, its a never ending relationship which I have to live with because of my preference to cold stuffs. I generally don't drink hot water, okay! I hate hot water. Hot water gargling is a horrible experience but have you done betadine gargling, oh boy! that is one bad experience. There was a time when a nasty throat pain hit me and it raised my body fever to such a level that I could barely move and then throat started getting infected and it reached a level where swallowing a bit of your own saliva was next to impossible. The air you breath through your mouth would hurt in such a way that breakup pain is like cake walk and the moment you take betadine gargle, you say praise the lord. So now I take cold stuff but I take it sip by sip like you sip whiskey on rocks. I wish none of you have to go through that ordeal because you have to stay sober for a week until you can consume anything cold so yeah! but hot water still sucks. Have you ever?

Okay that's all blogging for today!!

item.title: Wherefore art thou’?? Really?
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
For a second lets assume that I don't think about your or in other words miss you okay? Your disappearance from social media wasn't a shock for me but I did presume that one day your profile might pop up somewhere and I feel content that yes you do exist amidst the chaos. I don't think its a necessity that you would think about me or my thought would pop out into your mind out of a sudden reaction. I probably think you married and left to Europe somewhere far from my reach, probably its good that you are not near either. The only way to get a slight idea about you is the LinkedIn profile you still update or had updated a while back and I am quiet happy that I can someway read that you are safe somewhere but I did fail keeping in touch or being not there to share your feelings when you cant share with anyone? I think I regret a lot of that because somewhere deep inside a seed of your longing is still there, it still installs into my thought whenever I see something that reminds me of you. Last week I saw that same tree where we used to drink tea and smoke cigarettes' while you said you are leaving me and I was a little unsure how to react to it because I felt like someone robbed me of something valuable but I should have expressed what I felt for you even before everything started to fall, may be I should have shared my feeling to you rather than writing on captions back then.

I would ping you out of a random blue day when my thoughts about you cant be overpowered because there is no way to stack you right now or back then. But all you give me back is a psychological metaphors where in someway you make me realize that I am happy and you are still trying to figure out your life. All I could do is stalk your roomies stories or post but you never appeared on any of them and I realized that you are detached from theirs too. I am sorry that I couldn't be there but wherever we reached a common ground you always retraced saying that it wont work or it would cause more damage and I would like always, agree to what you say. I would then go back and ask myself , did I try enough to make an amendment or as usual go back listening to "Deform to Form a Star by Steven Wilson"?

I want you to understand that I never stopped trying to reach out to the people I know about you and if few of our mutual colleagues reached out to you is because I was desperate to know what you are doing? If you would have received random pings from ex colleagues then I would have someway convinced then to get some details of your current ordeal. I know if I reach out directly the information I receive would be reduced into half or may be there is no point in answering this delusional guy. Lets pretend I am delusional for a while but then I would have tried to create a havoc of pings but I am not, I am still waiting for that day to arrive when I would get a ping from you where we could start off the conversation from the place we stopped last time.

I never smoked a menthol cigarette since you left, next will always be with you because the start was with you. I can either wait until I am alive or may be next life I can recollect the memory if we are born into a universe where the tech is much savvy. Until then no more menthol cigarettes okay? I sometimes look at old pictures, may be oldest ethnic ones if you remember it correctly that was the first pic ever but little did I thought I would find comfort under you crazy smile and messages. Ever thought what happened was meant to happen at some point of time but somewhere deep inside I regret it.

I hope you find solace in your new place, may be you find comfort in the company around you and I hope they are making you giggle with new memes and puns. I don't know assume anything about you now because I don't have any information to assume on, its like staring into sunset its beautiful knowing and not knowing at the same time. I am hoping to get a ping from you someday, if not I can wait but for sure we will meet one day ,sit an speak for a while and share some cool tricks you learned or may be teach how do this social media detox on a serious note?

May be I would ping you again and wait for you metaphorical replies every year until you figure out that I am still the same old kid that shared that menthol with you while you made regular tea for me while everyone else drank ginger tea?

item.title: Melancholia
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
In life, pain the only real thing that is close to reality and rest all other emotions are passersby. I cant explain my mind right now, its happy, broken and lost at the same time and sometimes, I am oblivious to the purpose of my life. I have never been in this place before and this is very baffling for me because there are many things that needs my attention and I am not good at figuring out what's the priority of it. If only life was like Jira where someone can assign the priority of the thoughts so that I can tend to it rather than rambling around fixing this partially. If someone comes and asks me an example of what's bothering me, I cant pin point it because I feel my problems are shapeless.

I can ease down all of these thoughts with a smoke but does it help me once I am back to reality? No! so there is no running away from it because I have never stayed away from an ordeal because I thrive on it. I can handle pain in any magnitude because that's the most realistic feeling because being hurt opens thoughts to new perspectives but happiness/joy makes me stay at the same place for a prolonged time without realizing that its a moments mess.

Memories from the past doesn't reflect any of these feeling because past was a busy life with women and wine, there was only biased grief when either a bottle is empty or one walks out of the room but there will always be someone who walks in before that wound is mended. Life was tied between ecstasy and gluttony where emotions were not allowed to enter without permission and that busy life was fucking adrenalin rush every day.

I not longer dip my toes in sand, no longer wait to enjoy a perfect sunset because I am comfortable in walking away and I let people around me contemplate on the view and I peek through them what I am missing. Even if I plant a million versions of myself at this same moment half of them would walk away because these are paper moments and how many of sunset moments can you hoard in your memory even though you have seen a thousand sunsets, how many do you think you can keep a track on because sunsets are like that its a momentary visual, appreciate it and move on, don't linger thoughts around it and fantasize it.

item.title: Abundance...
item.dc:creator: thewaywardchimp
item.content:encoded:
I remember several moments in my lifetime, and few are stamped in my thoughts than my heart makes its easy to access because my mind would constantly think about it. Yesterday I was upset for a while thinking that I can no longer enjoy the smell of new curriculum books stacked on top of my table, skimming through chapters which I am going to learn once the vacation ends and that’s a massive loss once you level up in age. From getting kissed on your lips for the first time to saying one last goodbye as cab departs into distance, life demands not to carry all thoughts into the present and yet if I look back, I see and feel everything. When first love departed, I presumed that my life was at crossroads until I found love at another distance and once that departed I understood that I was never at crossroads, I need a solution and it was to not trip in love again.

First love, like everyone says, is cringe and cheesy because I was 19 back then. Being in love for a person like me attracted a lot of questions. One, being ugly and slim, is one thing, and secondly, dating a North Indian during college days was another thing. Love was all about hiding at every nook and cranny in the campus and spending time together, as there were not many smartphones back then. Plus, the campus was like a wide-open area with no entry or exit. Love was just like in the books – spending time under the trees, holding hands when no one was watching, and dancing together for any events. I was even summoned by the college principal just to lie to his face that there was nothing happening between us. But did that stop us from being in love? Absolutely not, because by the 3rd year, everyone in the batch had their respective pairs, and everyone was joyous over the college tours. Love was immense. I never left home without a kiss, and the first time I got a kiss on my lips was right in my house while my mom went to get a glass of water for her. Like I said, love was in abundance, and my first love was a roller coaster ride – from group studies to traveling together from Delhi to Kerala via Rajdhani Express for 3 days, to a surprise visit in Chennai as part of company training, to completing each other's diaries just to make sure love was in perfect balance. But fate had its own plan, as at one point, reality had to take a stand in between love and career. As time passed, things moved apart, and love became friends, and then friends became strangers, and then it became Instagram friends.

I chose to be alone for a while, even though it messed up my mind. I was distant from any form of love, and life became a routine. I tried to find some glimmer of happiness until a message came from miles away, from a country I usually only see during the football World Cup. Soon, that long-distance friendship became a routine, and slowly but steadily, I fell back into my pattern of falling in love again. With her, things were different. She was too young to be loved in the conventional way, so I had to imagine love being 5 years younger. This made me understand love in a completely different way. I realized I had a short temper, but I was willing to let go of things even if it hurt someone else. She taught me empathy and encouraged me to fill that void in me with love. Being in love with a Saurashtrian for more than 3 years, only to spend less than 48 hours together, was an unreal feat for me. The most cherished memory will always be holding her hand under the table while diverting her mom's attention to eat Kesari bath from Rajadhani Hotel in Chennai. This phase of love was the most emotional one, as emotions could only reach virtually. It can be considered the best one because I owe her everything for who I am today. She deserves credit for every Instagram caption I write, as I wrote the most love letters to her. A few words I still remember are "Mogo thogo jukku opairas".

Post this ordeal, I decided to ease down on social media and take a nosedive into focusing on my career goals. I started taking classes in Bangalore at a local institute to get an edge on the competition. But instead of career growth, I found love again. However, this time it wasn't me who initiated the conversation; it was a quote I had written on my book that caught that cute Tamil girl's attention. It started with her borrowing my books for missing the classes, and eventually led to her writing her number on my book. At first, I thought this was happening again and that I should have said no. But life seemed determined to throw me into love once more. With her, I roamed in and around Bangalore. Our love story was like something out of modern movies. We went on dinner dates, movie dates, and I hardly spent a weekend in my room talking to friends. Instead, I found myself at various cafés, swiping credit cards, and questioning if I could sustain this relationship without going broke. It was either the lecture or the love, and the time had come when I was about to do the Ladakh Expedition. When I returned from the trip, my thoughts had already shifted, leading to the impending breakup at Hole In The Wall Cafe, where we sat eating hot dogs and potato wedges. I am yet to forgive myself for this ordeal because I could have stopped at the moment where it all began. However, I was too curious to know how far it could go. From meeting her sisters and friends who kept asking me if I would marry her after dating for only a month, to discovering that her dad is a police officer in Bangalore, things became hard for me to contemplate. But by then, time had already decided a path for me—to walk away from club hopping and indulging in unhealthy habits every weekend. Love was there, but it was a little unhealthy.

Post Ladakh Expedition, my mind was fixated on traveling, and I spent more time writing on Instagram so that my mind could find peace. The moment you pen down your thoughts on paper, half of the headache vanishes. Loneliness overtook all other emotions, and love rusted at the windowpane for months until someone caught the attention of the stories I had been writing. This time we never named it love, but we knew we had a fire that couldn't be extinguished by words. This relationship also came from the North to the South. From watching Deadpool together to eating Ghee Rice and Boneless Chilli Chicken from Mughal, it was the start of something beautiful. She was my companion for everything, alongside my pet Oreo. We had a relationship that couldn't be named. Maybe I am the only one for whom she let her guard down and explained what was happening around her and in her mind. There were days I missed her, but as I said, time had different plans for this Mallu bird who flew away from my nest. But I always think and remember the days we spent together. She was a teacher for me from some perspectives. But, as I said, time and love are different for each other. No matter where you are, you will always feel that this feeling is temporary.

After that, I shifted to a new room and made a new set of friends. This change prevented me from overthinking because I found friends who needed someone new like me in their lives. Their lives had become routine, so I spent most of my time in a room inhaling cigarette smoke and endlessly drinking beer. However, this eventually ignited the desire to start writing again. I had stopped writing because of the impact it had on me and others, but life is circular and it always comes back to the starting point. Then, I encountered a person who was much older than me, someone who could challenge me in my thoughts and words. She was nine years older and her thoughts and perspective were impeccable because books were her life. She loved books and poetry, and her words reflected this passion. What she could convey in simple words was often difficult for me to grasp. This marked the beginning of something beautiful, but this time, I was like a student. We read books together, such as "Tuesdays with Morrie" and enjoyed moments of indulgence with coffee infused with Baileys Irish Cream Liqueur. Amidst the impending chaos, the days were good. She was the only person who ever gifted me a framed Porcupine Tree band poster, and it made me wonder if she truly knew me well. She was also the only person who gave me an original Rudraksha from Manali, even before I had been there. However, life had to pause for a while, and this avid Mallu reader had to take a leave. Our divergent choices gradually built a wall between us, and as time passed, we ended up on different paths. I have no idea what she is up to now, but I am quite certain she would be in a library, engrossed in reading more books. With her, my writing skills improved drastically, and for that, I am forever grateful. Whenever our paths cross again, I will always owe her.

Even though I long for a break from these trials and tribulations, having a companion, be it for a short journey or a long one, has its merits. Speaking of short journeys, I once met someone who was both wild and intelligent, someone who excelled in academics and had a passion for pilots. We spent a considerable amount of time together, from sneaking out of work to catch a movie at Central Mall to indulging in lunches at cafes in Sarjapur. Through this experience, I gained insight into the loneliness she felt as an only child and I tried my best to provide her with companionship. However, as they say, the path one chooses in life can inadvertently alter the course of others as well. While I wanted to stay in touch somehow, she flew away and I must shoulder the blame for it. At that time, I was caught up in a different company and failed to dedicate enough time. I should have offered a proper closure. Perhaps, one day, I will have the opportunity to explain these circumstances.

Talking about the upcoming person is very tough because it's very personal for me, and I did lose a lot of consciousness over her. If I am still not over someone in logical terms, then this is it because this was the first time, even without a thought, I fell in love. This was the time when I was the only one being in love, not from the other side. She was like a mirror image of what I am, and this was the first time I met someone who is crazy like me and who kissed me just because she missed me. At this point, I lost myself, and I had no control over what I am doing when I am next to her. I spend most evenings with her walking around the park without saying or uttering a single word. I would wait until she hugs me tight when it's time for me to head back home and would say I am already missed even before reaching home. The sad part of this relationship was that we figured out that we loved each other at the wrong time, and the timeline was already messy, and there was no going back for me. Only if I had the courage to ask like I always do, but this time I loved from afar, which made a lot of difference. Like I said again, due to an unlikely event in our life, we split ways without giving closure. From drinking tea under that red fruit tree to smoking menthol cigarettes under the rain, we could have been smiling still, but someday we will sit across tables and talk until we find a common point, only to realize we could have been friends. I do miss the fossette on your cheek, and you're the only person who made me smoke a menthol cigarette just because you like it.

Now let's take a step back. All of these are compilations of the memories that are still intact, and I do revisit them in my thoughts because these memories have shaped me and helped me understand my vulnerabilities. I never wanted to leave anything without closure, but not everyone thinks the same, and some don't like closures because life is an open-ended string. You will always find something to tie it to, whether it's a person or a rock underwater. That's life. No matter where you are now, you will always feel that this isn't where you are supposed to be. Everyone is caged by their own thoughts; the foolish ones believe life is free and boundless.
